title: No-Parking Zone
description: Parking in a designated no-parking area may constitute a parking violation.
resolution: Move the vehicle if it is still present.
Check the applicable local parking procedure.
Review the applicable dispute process if you believe the violation is incorrect.

title: Emergency Access Obstruction
description: Vehicles should not obstruct designated emergency access areas.
resolution: Review the applicable dispute process if necessary.

title: Accessible Parking Violation
description: Designated accessible parking spaces are reserved for eligible users according to applicable rules.
resolution: Correct the parking situation if applicable.
Review the official dispute procedure if necessary.

title: Parking Time Limit Violation
description: Parking may be restricted by a specified time limit in designated areas.
resolution: Check the posted parking time limit.

title: Wrong Direction Parking
description: Parking may be restricted when a vehicle is parked against the permitted direction of traffic.
resolution: Correct the parking position if necessary.

title: Double Parking
description: Double parking occurs when a vehicle is parked alongside another parked vehicle, obstructing it or preventing its driver from moving or leaving.
resolution: Check whether the vehicle is obstructing another vehicle.
Check the official dispute procedure if necessary.

title: Blocked Driveway
description: A driveway violation occurs when a vehicle is parked across or in front of a driveway, garage entrance, or vehicle access point, preventing entry or exit.
resolution: Check whether the driveway is obstructed.
Check the applicable dispute procedure if necessary.
